notes.note: Reviewed for the cover keyboard fix (input: src-desktop/src/lib.rs). The change only makes the macOS startup cover's key monitor select the next/previous key view on Tab/Shift-Tab and press the focused cover button on Space. Searched this document for startup cover, keyboard and readiness claims affected by it and found none. No prose change.

Re-checked the cover keyboard sentence against the Tab/Shift-Tab/Space change in lib.rs: the monitor now performs selectNextKeyView/selectPreviousKeyView and presses the focused cover button itself (tao's content view consumes keys passed back to AppKit). The documented behaviour (Tab/Shift-Tab/Space reach only the cover's own buttons) is unchanged and accurate.
